A four-step introduction / reviewed 2026-09-24

GenAI 101

A practical first path through generative AI, ChatGPT, everyday prompting and context design for AI practitioners.

Start with a task you understand.

Learn the basic idea, try a useful ChatGPT workflow, improve everyday requests, then see how practitioners shape context for multi-step AI work.

STEP 01

GenAI for everyone: no jargon

A friendly starting point: what generative AI does, where it helps, and why fluent answers still need checking.

STEP 02

Your ChatGPT journey: first task to steady workflow

A repeatable path from a first question to a checked result, with product features treated as optional tools rather than assumptions.

STEP 03

Prompting for everyday users

Plain-language instructions beat magic phrases. A small checklist makes everyday requests clearer and easier to review.

STEP 04

Context engineering for AI practitioners

Move beyond one prompt: curate the right instructions, evidence, history and tools for the model’s next step.

Sources across the field

This module draws on public material from Microsoft, Google Cloud, NIST, Anthropic, a university guide and OpenAI product documentation. Each lesson links directly to the sources behind it.
